nativeBehavior: Compact and outline two-real-row reports followed by Values have separate outer and inner heading rows. Compact indentation is 0 for outer headings, 1 for inner headings, 2 for measure rows, and 0 for subtotal/grand rows. Top and bottom automatic subtotal flags both render below the group when Values is on rows.
supported: Tabular/compact/outline, one or two real row fields then Values, 2 to 16 measures, optional one column field, automatic or disabled outer subtotals and repeated outline/tabular labels.
preserved: Values before/between real fields, custom indentation/subtotals, grouping/filters/slicers/shared cache/visible or custom Values header profiles remain unsupported and preserved.
tests: Every native cached/refreshed cell value/type/dimension, compact indentation and left alignment; all six layout conversions, source changes, collapse to one row/measure, source XML preservation, browser history/save/reopen.
reuse: Extends shared indexed hierarchy aggregation, headers, row-item serialization and stylePatcher. UI contains no pivot calculation or format logic.
